detail.longDescription: Hi everyone. I’ve been working on something over the past little while: a plugin for Jellyfin that streams the content from the AudioVault on demand. Headline features include: • Every AudioVault movie and show is searchable in Jellyfin, and integrates with Jellyfins metadata providers and other systems, even before getting downloaded. • Press play and it downloads that title, so nothing is downloaded until someone wants it. • Plays on any Jellyfin app, and stays cached. • Each user uses their own AudioVault account, and the plugin keeps to AudioVault’s download limits. It’s free and open source. You need Jellyfin 12.2 and an AudioVault account. For installation instructions, and other docs, visit the repo https:// github.com/JessicaTegner/jelly fin-plugin-audiovault # Jellyfin # AudioDescription # Accessibility # Blind # SelfHosted # OpenSource # audiovault
